meta.title: Read your prescription
meta.description: Take a photo of your prescription and see each medicine, when to take it and what to watch for, in English, Urdu or Sindhi.

common.comingSoon: This part is being built and will be ready in a later stage.
common.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes, especially with handwriting. Always confirm with your pharmacist or doctor.

home.heroText: Take a photo. We'll show you each medicine, when to take it, and what to watch out for, in English, Urdu or Sindhi.
home.reassure: Free to use. Your photo is read by AI and is not saved on our server.

steps.title: Take a photo of the prescription
steps.text: Fit the whole page in good light.

steps.title: Check what we read
steps.text: Compare it with your prescription and fix anything that looks wrong.

steps.title: See a simple summary
steps.text: Medicines, timings and warnings, all in one place.

pages.historyText: Prescriptions you scan will be saved only on this phone. You can delete them at any time.
pages.aboutText: We are a local pharmacy in Sindh. This tool helps you understand your prescription in your own language. Our pharmacist is always happy to check it with you in person.
pages.contactText: Call, send a WhatsApp message, or visit us at the pharmacy.
privacyPoints: Your prescription photo is sent to an AI service (Anthropic's Claude) only to read it.
We do not save your photo or prescription details on our server.
Your past scans are kept only on your own phone, and you can delete them at any time.
We never sell or share your information.
pages.privacyDraft: This is a draft. The full policy will be added before the website goes live.
